summary: The generator inventory plugin uses Jinja2 templates and layers in a YAML config to create a host for every combination of layer values, with templated parent groups.
questions: How do I generate many inventory hosts from patterns?
What does the generator inventory plugin do?

answer_card.title: generator inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.generator` uses a YAML config with a host name template and independent **layers**. Every combination of layer values becomes a host, and parent groups can be defined from the same template variables.
